newsitem.title: UK: UK govt says bill to clarify NHS trusts' PFI power.
newsitem.headline: UK govt says bill to clarify NHS trusts' PFI power.

text.p: The government said on Wednesday it is to introduce legislation to clarify the rights of National Health Service Trusts to enter into partnerships with the private sector.

The measure, announced by Queen Elizabeth in her speech opening the new session of parliament, will declare that Trusts have the power to enter into Private Finance Initiative contracts, government officials said.
They said Health Secretary Frank Dobson will be given the power to certify a contract as a PFI contract provided it meets criteria to be set out in the bill. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
